title: Christmas Fritters with Spiced Pudding
description: A sweet dessert recipe featuring crispy fritters topped with a warm spiced pudding.
instructions: Preheat the oil in a deep frying pan to 375°F (190°C).
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, baking powder, sugar, and nutmeg.
In a separate bowl, whisk together the eggs, milk, and melted butter.
Add the wet ingredients to the dry ingredients and stir until just combined.
Using a cookie scoop, drop the batter into the hot oil, about 1/4 cupfuls.
Fry the fritters for 2-3 minutes on each side, or until golden brown.
Using a slotted spoon, remove the fritters from the oil and place on a paper towel-lined plate.
To make the pudding, combine the pudding mix and milk in a medium saucepan.
Cook over medium heat, stirring constantly, until the pudding comes to a boil.
Remove from heat and stir in any additional spices or flavorings.
Serve the fritters warm with the spiced pudding spooned over the top.
